items.name: Flint & Tinder
items.effect: Required to light torches, candles, or lanterns, and to make a fire.
items.description: A small kit containing flint and tinder, used to start fires.

items.name: Lamp Oil
items.effect: Holds ten doses. Each dose keeps an oil lamp or lantern burning for up to one shift of time.
items.description: A small jug of oil used to fuel lamps and lanterns.

items.name: Lantern
items.effect: Lights 10m radius for a shift, roll D8 each stretch. On 1 it goes out and needs refill.
items.description: A metal lantern that can be used to light a small area.

items.name: Oil Lamp
items.effect: Lights 10m radius for a shift, roll D6 each stretch. On 1 it goes out and needs refill.
items.description: A small oil lamp that can be used to light a small area.

items.name: Tallow Candle
items.effect: Lights 4m radius for a shift, roll D4 each stretch. On 1 it goes out.
items.description: A small candle made of tallow, used to provide light.

items.name: Torch
items.effect: Lights 4m radius for a shift, roll D6 each stretch or used as weapon. On 1 it goes out.
items.description: A wooden stick with a cloth soaked in oil at one end, used to provide light.
